tagline: A sequence-defined SELP hydrogel with a SnoopTag2 plug socket, so one cartilage scaffold can be reconfigured by swapping functional peptides
tagline_zh: 一款序列明確定義的 SELP 水凝膠，搭配 SnoopTag2 插槽，因此同一個軟骨支架只要更換功能性胜肽就能重新配置
summary: ZJU-China built NEST, a silk-elastin-like protein (SELP) hydrogel carrying SnoopTag2 as a standardised ligation interface, so that repair peptides (Link-N, a chondroitin-sulfate-retaining CPC module, a magnetically responsive anisotropy module, a mitochondrial delivery module) can be attached without redesigning the material. They engineered a SnoopLigase2-ZJU variant for the ligation chemistry, purified SELP by inverse transition cycling optimised to 65 degrees C in PBS with 2 M NaCl, and validated GAG binding by AviTag-BirA site-specific biotinylation onto streptavidin beads with DMMB quantification. The commercial case is a full process-economics build rather than a canvas, with equipment, land, working capital, medium, IPTG, kanamycin, labour by shift and waste volumes all costed, plus a 2026-2042 stage-gated roadmap and a ten-year discounted cash-flow model. They were nominated for Best Entrepreneurship (Undergrad) and Best Biomanufacturing.
summary_zh: ZJU-China 打造了 NEST，一種帶有 SnoopTag2 作為標準化連接介面的絲蛋白-彈性蛋白樣蛋白（SELP）水凝膠，使修復用胜肽（Link-N、一個可保留硫酸軟骨素的 CPC 模組、一個具磁響應性的非等向性模組、一個粒線體遞送模組）能夠直接接上，而不必重新設計材料本身。團隊為這套連接化學改造出 SnoopLigase2-ZJU 變異體，以反相轉變循環純化 SELP 並將條件最佳化為含 2 M NaCl 的 PBS、65 度 C，並以 AviTag-BirA 位點專一性生物素化接到鏈黴親和素磁珠上、再以 DMMB 定量來驗證 GAG 結合。商業論證是一份完整的製程經濟模型，而不是一張商業模式圖：設備、土地、營運資金、培養基、IPTG、卡那黴素、按班別計算的人力與廢棄物量全部估算成本，另有 2026-2042 的階段關卡路線圖與一套十年折現現金流模型。團隊入圍 Best Entrepreneurship（大學部）與 Best Biomanufacturing。

dry.frameworks: TAM-SAM-SOM with a documented estimation basis and a stated conversion coefficient from osteoarthritis prevalence to the cartilage-repair addressable population, three-tier competitor analysis, NREL-style techno-economic cost structure (fixed capital investment, land, working capital, variable and fixed operating costs, annual capex), a ten-year cash-flow and NPV model, a Sustainable Business Model Canvas, a tiered critical/high risk register tied to stage-gate decisions, a staged financing plan from angel through Series B, a skill-gap analysis across eight capability areas, and a TCFD-shaped ESG framework (governance, strategy, risk and opportunity, metrics and targets).
dry.frameworks_zh: TAM-SAM-SOM 架構，附有明確記錄的估算依據，以及一個由骨關節炎盛行率換算到軟骨修復可觸及人口的轉換係數；三層級競爭者分析；NREL 式的技術經濟成本結構（固定資本投資、土地、營運資金、變動與固定營運成本、年度資本支出）；一套十年現金流與 NPV 模型；一張永續商業模式圖；一份依關鍵/高風險分級並綁定階段關卡決策的風險清冊；一套由天使輪到 B 輪的分階段籌資計畫；橫跨八個能力領域的技能落差分析；以及一個依 TCFD 架構撰寫的 ESG 框架（治理、策略、風險與機會、指標與目標）。
dry.dataviz: Nine entrepreneurship figures: SAM and SOM projections, a three-panel budget classification and estimation-basis summary, the 2026-2042 roadmap across R&D, manufacturing, regulatory, fundraising and commercialisation lanes, a ten-year cash-flow chart distinguishing inflows, outflows, net and discounted cash flows, the business model canvas, a skills radar, and three competition-award photographs. A downloadable NEST cost sheet PDF carries the underlying calculations, and five per-module notebook PDFs back the wet-lab work.
dry.dataviz_zh: 九張創業相關圖表：SAM 與 SOM 推估、一張三面板的預算分類與估算依據彙總、橫跨研發、製造、法規、募資與商業化五條軌道的 2026-2042 路線圖、一張區分流入、流出、淨現金流與折現現金流的十年現金流圖、商業模式圖、一張技能雷達圖，以及三張競賽獲獎照片。可下載的 NEST 成本表 PDF 內含底層計算，另有五份各模組的實驗紀錄 PDF 支撐濕實驗成果。
dry.datascience: The costing is done from first principles rather than from benchmarks. Required SELP output for the initial market is derived first, then equipment is sized against it, giving major equipment of CNY 7.45 million (about USD 1.11 million) estimated with input from Beijing Weixinkang Medical. Consumables are itemised: roughly CNY 290,700 per year for the three main LB components, 7.47 kg of IPTG and 1.57 kg of kanamycin annually, plus PBS and sodium chloride for purification, and about 31,360 L of spent culture medium as annual waste. Labour is modelled as a sum over operations of fully loaded hourly cost, with day and night shifts priced separately against actual Zhejiang biomanufacturing job adverts (CNY 6,000-8,000 per month, conservatively the low end) and Hangzhou cleaner salaries, totalling about CNY 2.6603 million per year. The cash-flow model uses a 10 percent real cost of capital, a 13.27 percent revenue CAGR from a cartilage-repair market report and 2 percent annual cost inflation at a fixed USD 1 = CNY 6.72.
dry.datascience_zh: 成本估算是從第一原理做起，而不是照抄業界標竿。團隊先推導出初期市場所需的 SELP 產量，再據此估算設備規模，得到主要設備約 745 萬 CNY（約 111 萬 USD），此數字參考了 Beijing Weixinkang Medical 的意見。耗材逐項列出：三種主要 LB 成分每年約 290,700 CNY、每年 7.47 kg 的 IPTG 與 1.57 kg 的卡那黴素，加上純化用的 PBS 與氯化鈉，以及每年約 31,360 L 的廢培養基。人力成本以各項操作的全額負擔時薪加總建模，日班與夜班分別定價，依據浙江生物製造業的實際徵才廣告（每月 6,000-8,000 CNY，保守取下限）與杭州清潔人員薪資，合計每年約 266.03 萬 CNY。現金流模型採 10% 的實質資金成本、取自一份軟骨修復市場報告的 13.27% 營收 CAGR，以及每年 2% 的成本通膨，匯率固定為 1 USD = 6.72 CNY。

good.publicEngagement: A committed rather than rhetorical plan: during R&D they intend to spend at least CNY 50,000 annually on patient education, public lectures and open science materials, support SynEduGlobal for synthetic-biology education, establish a charitable fund for rural medical outreach and cartilage-health awareness, and continue working with Non-place Studio to use art to build understanding of synthetic biology and empathy for people with cartilage injuries. They also name limited public understanding of hydrogel therapy as a genuine commercial risk to patient confidence and access, not just a communications gap.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 這是一份有承諾而非只是說法的計畫：團隊打算在研發期間每年至少投入 50,000 CNY 於病患教育、公眾講座與開放科學素材，支持 SynEduGlobal 推動合成生物學教育，設立一筆慈善基金用於偏鄉醫療推廣與軟骨健康意識宣導，並持續與 Non-place Studio 合作，以藝術建立社會對合成生物學的理解，以及對軟骨損傷患者的同理。團隊也把公眾對水凝膠療法理解有限一事，指認為對病患信心與可及性的實質商業風險，而不只是溝通上的落差。
good.ihp: Their iHP is organised as design-build-test-learn cycles, with an Implementation stage split into hardware, industrial production and entrepreneurship cycles. The entrepreneurship cycle consulted stakeholders across manufacturing, sales, government regulation, finance and entrepreneurship support, and the documented consequence is specific: they gave cost greater weight in the material design, built the detailed business model, went looking for a CDMO partner, and secured a first expression of investment interest. Clinicians fed back that the material's complexity could complicate market approval, which pushed attention toward regulatory simplicity. Professor Erik Forsberg guided the cash-flow and NPV analysis, and Beijing Weixinkang Medical supplied the equipment cost estimates, so industry input is embedded in the numbers rather than quoted alongside them.
good.ihp_zh: 他們的整合式人類實踐以設計-建構-測試-學習（DBTL）循環編排，其中「落實」階段再分為硬體、工業生產與創業三個循環。創業循環諮詢了製造、銷售、政府法規、財務與創業輔導等各方利害關係人，而留下紀錄的後果相當具體：團隊在材料設計中給了成本更高的權重、建立了詳細的商業模式、開始尋找 CDMO 夥伴，並取得了第一份投資意向。臨床醫師回饋指出材料的複雜度可能使上市審查變得棘手，這使團隊把注意力轉向法規上的簡潔性。Erik Forsberg 教授指導了現金流與 NPV 分析，Beijing Weixinkang Medical 則提供設備成本估算，因此業界意見是嵌進數字裡，而不是擺在數字旁邊引用。
good.realWorld: A genuinely serious venture attempt with one glaring soft spot. The strong parts first. The business model is a phased B2B: research partnerships and technology-development licensing early to build relationships and validate demand, then supply of implant material and delivery solutions to clinical institutions, with orthopaedic companies and hospitals as customers and patients explicitly identified as beneficiaries rather than initial sales targets. Research grants and equity are accounted separately from operating income, which is a distinction most teams blur. The MVP is honestly narrow, the SELP-SnoopTag2 hydrogel alone, with production and storage stability already demonstrated in the lab and the remaining path stated plainly: classification confirmation, product testing, animal studies, clinical trials, NMPA registration, and a medical-device manufacturing licence for the manufacturer, expected to take ten years. The first indication is focal knee-cartilage defects in China, chosen for surgical volume and clinical-evidence base. The cost model is the standout: equipment, land, working capital, itemised media and reagents, shift-differentiated labour, and waste volumes, published as a downloadable cost sheet. Financing is staged and concrete, with real named programmes and amounts: Hangzhou's 5050 Plan (CNY 1 million start-up, up to CNY 10 million in R&D grants), up to CNY 6 million for a first Class III registration manufactured in Hangzhou via Hangzhou Medical Port, up to USD 500,000 from the GenScript Life Science Research Fund, and crucially a named investor, Ms. Zhang Jie of Huadan Angel, who in a stakeholder interview expressed willingness to discuss roughly CNY 1.5 million after first-round samples meet expectations. Industrial relationships are specific and functional rather than decorative: Weixinkang and Lanyiwei on Class III manufacturing and market access, Yuanyi Bio on fermentation and purification, Yiru Bio on scale-up, Shanghai Lingjiu Medical as a possible CDMO, WuXi AppTec's device-testing centre for registration testing, and Evonik, Arthrex and Smith+Nephew as international targets. They won Gold at Zhejiang University's Dandelion Student Innovation Competition (with prize money) and two Golds at SynBio Challenges 2026, in both the main and the industry track, the latter for the SnoopLigase2-ZJU enzyme system, which is independent validation outside iGEM. IP is planned with real specificity: a Chinese invention patent to be filed in November 2026 covering the SELP-SnoopTag2 structure, manufacturing and purification methods, hydrogel formulation, crosslinking system and peptide attachment, with a prior-art search on SnoopTag2, SELP and Ru/SPS crosslinking before any public data release, and the correct observation that treatment methods are not patentable in China so claims must sit on products and manufacturing. The roadmap is stage-gated across 2026-2042 with a criterion and a required-resources list for each window, and they say outright that they will not assign a break-even year or market-share forecast without a defensible financial model. Now the blunt part. That restraint is contradicted by the headline number: a ten-year NPV of about USD 427 million on an initial investment of about USD 8.69 million, produced by assuming NEST captures 10, 25, 50, 75 and then 100 percent of its SOM in years one to five and holds 100 percent of SOM for years six to ten. Capturing the entire serviceable obtainable market and keeping it, for a Class III implant that by their own roadmap will not be registered until roughly 2037, is not a scenario; it is an upper bound, and they label it only as 'favorable assumptions'. There is also no incorporated entity (the name NexCode Biotechnologies appears but no registration is claimed), no filed patent yet, no signed investment, and no animal data at all, which they state clearly as a limitation on any safety or efficacy claim. The honest reading is that the cost side of this model is excellent and the revenue side is aspirational.
good.realWorld_zh: 這是一次真正認真的創業嘗試，但有一處明顯的軟肋。先談強的部分。商業模式是分階段的 B2B：早期以研究合作與技術開發授權建立關係並驗證需求，之後再向臨床機構供應植入材料與遞送方案，客戶為骨科公司與醫院，而病患被明確定義為受益者，而不是初期的銷售對象。研究補助與股權募資與營運收入分開記帳，這是多數團隊會混在一起的區分。MVP 的範圍很誠實地窄，只有 SELP-SnoopTag2 水凝膠本身，其生產與儲存穩定性已在實驗室中驗證，剩下的路徑也明白寫出：分類確認、產品檢測、動物試驗、臨床試驗、NMPA 註冊，以及製造商的醫療器材製造許可，預期需要十年。第一個適應症是中國的膝關節局部軟骨缺損，選擇理由是手術量與臨床證據基礎。成本模型是最突出的部分：設備、土地、營運資金、逐項列出的培養基與試劑、區分班別的人力，以及廢棄物量，全部做成可下載的成本表公開。籌資規劃分階段且具體，列出真實的計畫名稱與金額：杭州的 5050 計畫（100 萬 CNY 創業金，研發補助最高 1,000 萬 CNY）、透過 Hangzhou Medical Port 在杭州製造並取得第一張第三類註冊最高可得 600 萬 CNY、GenScript Life Science Research Fund 最高 500,000 USD，而關鍵是還有一位具名投資人，Huadan Angel 的 Zhang Jie 女士，她在利害關係人訪談中表示，待第一輪樣品達到預期後，願意洽談約 150 萬 CNY。產業關係具體且具功能性，而不是拿來裝飾：Weixinkang 與 Lanyiwei 負責第三類製造與市場准入、Yuanyi Bio 負責發酵與純化、Yiru Bio 負責放大量產、Shanghai Lingjiu Medical 為可能的 CDMO、WuXi AppTec 的器材檢測中心負責註冊檢測，而 Evonik、Arthrex 與 Smith+Nephew 則列為國際目標對象。團隊在浙江大學 Dandelion Student Innovation Competition 獲金獎（含獎金），並在 SynBio Challenges 2026 的主賽道與產業賽道各拿一面金獎，後者是憑 SnoopLigase2-ZJU 酶系統，屬於 iGEM 之外的獨立驗證。智財規劃也有實際的細節：預計於 2026 年 11 月提出一件中國發明專利，涵蓋 SELP-SnoopTag2 結構、製造與純化方法、水凝膠配方、交聯系統與胜肽接合，並在任何資料公開前先就 SnoopTag2、SELP 與 Ru/SPS 交聯做先前技術檢索；團隊也正確地指出治療方法在中國不可專利，因此請求項必須落在產品與製造上。路線圖在 2026-2042 間設有階段關卡，每個時間窗都附一條判準與一份所需資源清單，而他們也直言，在沒有站得住腳的財務模型之前，不會指定損益兩平年度或市佔率預測。現在談直白的部分。這份自制卻被最醒目的那個數字推翻了：以約 869 萬 USD 的初始投資，推出約 4.27 億 USD 的十年 NPV，而計算方式是假設 NEST 在第一到第五年分別拿下 SOM 的 10%、25%、50%、75% 然後 100%，並在第六到第十年持續握有 100% 的 SOM。對一項依他們自己的路線圖大約要到 2037 年才會註冊完成的第三類植入物來說，吃下整個可服務可取得市場並一直守住，並不是一種情境，而是一個上限；他們卻只把它標為「有利假設」。此外，公司實體並不存在（文中出現 NexCode Biotechnologies 這個名稱，但沒有宣稱已完成登記）、專利尚未提出、投資尚未簽約，動物實驗資料也完全沒有，而這一點他們自己明確列為任何安全性或療效主張的限制。誠實的讀法是：這個模型的成本面極為出色，營收面則屬一廂情願。

gemsTakeaway: Copy their bottom-up cost sheet: size the required output first, then let equipment, media, IPTG and antibiotic quantities, shift-differentiated labour rates taken from real local job adverts, and annual waste volumes fall out of it, and publish the whole thing as a downloadable file. Then apply the discipline they stated but did not follow on their own revenue line: never model capturing 100 percent of a serviceable obtainable market, and label any such figure as an upper bound rather than a forecast.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 抄下他們那份自下而上的成本表：先把所需產量定出來，再讓設備、培養基、IPTG 與抗生素用量、取自真實當地徵才廣告並區分班別的人力費率，以及年度廢棄物量全部由此推導出來，最後把整份資料做成可下載的檔案公開。接著，把他們自己說了卻沒有做到的紀律套用到營收那一側：永遠不要把模型設定成拿下可服務可取得市場的 100%，而且任何這類數字都該標示為上限，而不是預測。
